title: SSC CHSL 2026 - Last 3 Days to Apply, Closes May 31 | 3,000+ Vacancies for LDC, JSA, DEO Posts
author: Ash K.
summary: SSC CHSL 2026 notification released April 30. Online application closes May 31, 2026 - only 3 days left. 3,000+ vacancies for LDC, JSA, Postal Assistant, Sorting Assistant, and DEO posts across central government ministries. Eligibility: 12th pass, age 18–27. Application fee: ₹100 for General/OBC/EWS male. Tier 1 exam: July–September 2026.
body: The SSC CHSL 2026 application window closes on May 31, 2026 - just 3 days away. The Staff Selection Commission released the official notification on April 30, 2026, for 3,000+ vacancies in posts like Lower Divisional Clerk (LDC), Junior Secretariat Assistant (JSA), Postal Assistant (PA), Sorting Assistant (SA), and Data Entry Operator (DEO) across central government ministries and departments. If you are a 12th pass candidate between 18–27 years of age, this is one of the most accessible central government job opportunities of 2026.

DetailInformation
Notification DateApril 30, 2026
Application Last DateMay 31, 2026 - 3 days left
Total Vacancies3,000+ (exact count in notification PDF)
PostsLDC, JSA, Postal Assistant, Sorting Assistant, DEO
Educational Qualification12th pass from any recognised board
Age Limit18–27 years as on May 31, 2026
Age RelaxationSC/ST: 5 years | OBC-NCL: 3 years | PwD: 10 years
Application Fee (General/OBC/EWS Male)₹100
Application Fee (Female/SC/ST/PwD/Ex-SM)NIL - fully exempted
Apply Websitessc.gov.in (via One-Time Registration)
Tier 1 Exam DateJuly–September 2026
InterviewNo interview at any stage
Starting Salary₹19,900/month (LDC/JSA) to ₹25,500/month (DEO) + HRA + TA

How to apply in 3 steps: Go to ssc.gov.in → Complete One-Time Registration (OTR) if not done - you need Aadhaar, mobile number, and email → Log in and fill the CHSL 2026 application form → Upload photo and signature → Pay ₹100 fee (via UPI, Net Banking, Debit Card) → Submit and save your application number. You can also apply via the MySSC mobile app. Do not wait for May 31 - SSC servers slow down heavily on deadline day.

Tier 1 exam pattern: 100 questions, 200 marks, 60 minutes. Four sections: English Language (25 Qs, 50 marks), General Intelligence (25 Qs, 50 marks), Quantitative Aptitude (25 Qs, 50 marks), General Awareness (25 Qs, 50 marks). Negative marking: 0.50 marks per wrong answer. Tier 1 is qualifying/shortlisting in nature - Tier 2 marks decide final merit.

Tier 2 exam: Two sessions - Session I includes Mathematical Abilities and Reasoning & General Intelligence (mandatory for all), Session II includes English Language/Comprehension and General Awareness (mandatory for all), and Module-II includes a Skill Test (Typing Test for LDC/JSA/PA/SA; Computer Proficiency Test for DEO posts). No interview is conducted at any stage of SSC CHSL.

Posts and salary overview: Lower Divisional Clerk (LDC) and Junior Secretariat Assistant (JSA) - Pay Level 2 (₹19,900–₹63,200). Postal Assistant/Sorting Assistant - Pay Level 4 (₹25,500–₹81,100). Data Entry Operator - Pay Level 4 or 5 depending on the department. Add House Rent Allowance (HRA) and Transport Allowance (TA) based on city of posting. See our complete SSC CHSL exam guide for full syllabus and preparation strategy, or check the SSC CGL guide for graduate-level SSC posts.

faqs.question: What is the last date to apply for SSC CHSL 2026?
faqs.answer: The last date to apply for SSC CHSL 2026 is May 31, 2026. Apply at ssc.gov.in as early as possible - servers slow down heavily on the deadline day. Female, SC, ST, PwD, and Ex-Servicemen candidates pay no application fee.

faqs.question: How many vacancies are in SSC CHSL 2026?
faqs.answer: SSC CHSL 2026 has 3,000+ vacancies for posts including LDC, JSA, Postal Assistant, Sorting Assistant, and DEO across central government ministries and departments. Exact post-wise and category-wise vacancy count is in the official notification PDF at ssc.gov.in.

faqs.question: What is the eligibility for SSC CHSL 2026?
faqs.answer: Candidates must have passed Class 12 (10+2) from any recognised board. Age limit is 18 to 27 years as on May 31, 2026. Age relaxation: SC/ST get 5 years, OBC-NCL get 3 years, and PwD candidates get 10 years of relaxation.

faqs.question: What is the salary in SSC CHSL 2026?
faqs.answer: LDC and JSA posts carry Pay Level 2 (₹19,900–₹63,200/month). Postal Assistant and Sorting Assistant are Pay Level 4 (₹25,500–₹81,100/month). DEO posts are at Pay Level 4 or 5. HRA and Transport Allowance are added based on city of posting.

faqs.question: Is there any interview in SSC CHSL 2026?
faqs.answer: No. SSC CHSL has no interview at any stage. Selection is entirely based on Tier 1 (qualifying CBT), Tier 2 (merit-based CBT), and Skill Test (Typing Test or Computer Proficiency Test depending on post).

faqs.question: When is the SSC CHSL 2026 Tier 1 exam?
faqs.answer: SSC CHSL 2026 Tier 1 (Computer Based Exam) is scheduled between July and September 2026. Exact dates will be announced separately. Admit cards are released 3–5 days before the exam.

callout.heading: Only 3 Days Left - Apply Today, Not May 31
callout.content: SSC CHSL 2026 application closes May 31. SSC servers crash on the last day every year. Apply at ssc.gov.in right now. Keep your 12th marksheet, Aadhaar, and a passport photo + signature scan ready. The whole process takes under 20 minutes.
